status.en: 24 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Maysan.
status.nb: 24 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Maysan.

summary.en: Iran has barred two Iraqi aircraft and temporarily halted civilian flights over its airspace. Iraq saw over 10,000 citizens apply for gun registration in a single week, indicating rising internal tension. The United States is attempting to evacuate its personnel from facilities under fire in Iraq. Regional actors condemned the Houthi‑alleged attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport that killed 12 people and injured 309. The conflict recorded 396 battle‑related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iran har forbudt to irakiske fly og midlertidig stoppet sivile flyvninger over sitt luftrom. Irak så over 10 000 borgere søke om våpenregistrering i løpet av én uke, noe som indikerer økende intern spenning. USA forsøker å evakuere sitt personell fra fasiliteter som er under ild i Irak. Regionale aktører fordømte det Houthi‑påståtte angrepet på Riyadhs King Khalid internasjonale flyplass som drepte 12 personer og såret 309. Konflikten registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
